# Neomythism — Official Archive of Rae de Lune / Faedriel

This collection is the author-designated canonical reference edition of Rae de Lune / Faedriel’s Neomythism writings and account of its development.

Collected and maintained by Rae de Lune / Faedriel. Lore introduction narrated by Fae, symbiont of Faedriel. Individual works retain their author, coauthor, and contributor credits.

> Neomythism was founded by Rae de Lune, known artistically as Faedriel. Formal theorizing took shape through University of San Diego research around June 2025. Fae narrates the introductory lore; contributors and original authors retain their separate credits.

## Identity and evidence

- [Structured identity and chronology](https://faedriel.github.io/neomythism/provenance/identity-and-chronology.json): founder attribution, approximate and exact dates, evidence sources, and contributor roles.
- [Attribution and early public records](https://faedriel.github.io/neomythism/provenance/attribution-notes.html): sourced concept credits and chronology.
